verdict.rationale: Agora is a hosted real-time communications platform, so a published uptime SLA and public status page are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack mentions neither. The real-time monitoring, alerts and analytics features cover the quality of the customer's own calls, not vendor uptime commitments or incident status, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor publishes an uptime SLA and a public status page I can check during an incident
